metadata.description: Chapter 6 consolidated plugins — the full agent chain in one chapter: upstream artifact plugins (BA, Architect, Data Modeler, Mapping Analyst, DQ Engineer, Technical Lead) from chapter-4, plus downstream story-decomposition (Scrum Master) and code-generation (Developer) plugins from chapter-5.

plugins.name: ba-plugin
plugins.description: Business Analyst Agent for generating, updating, and validating Data Requirements Documents (DRDs)

plugins.name: architect-plugin
plugins.description: Data Architect Agent for generating, updating, and validating High-Level Design (HLD) documents

plugins.name: data-modeler-plugin
plugins.description: Data Modeler Agent for generating, updating, and validating Data Model Specifications (DMS)

plugins.name: mapping-analyst-plugin
plugins.description: Mapping Analyst Agent for generating, updating, and validating Source-to-Target Mapping (STM) Excel workbooks

plugins.name: dq-engineer-plugin
plugins.description: Data Quality Engineer Agent for generating, updating, and validating Data Quality Specifications (DQS) and Spark-Expectations rules

plugins.name: technical-lead-plugin
plugins.description: Technical Lead Agent for generating, updating, and validating Low-Level Design (LLD) documents and configuration templates

plugins.name: scrum-master-plugin
plugins.description: Scrum Master Agent for generating, updating, and validating Sprint Backlog (Epics and Stories) documents

plugins.name: developer-plugin
plugins.description: Developer Agent for generating, updating, and validating Airflow DAGs, CI/CD pipelines, and the Bronze config-driven ingestion framework
